'''Zera''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She served in ranks of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] and was a partner of the [[Knight-Captain]] [[Senya Tirall]], who had saved Zera's life countless time over the years. Fiercely devoted to Senya, Zera was asked by her partner to defect and join the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] during the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zera appears during "The Nathema Conspiracy" flashpoint only if the player made the Dark Side choice to kill [[Senya Tirall]] during ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''. In this case, Zera will seek revenge on [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] and join the [[Order of Zildrog]] led by [[Vinn Atrius]], only to be sacrificed as fuel to awaken [[Zildrog]] by [[GEMINI 16]] on [[Nathema]]. If the player makes the Light Side choice, Senya remains alive and Zera has no reason to seek revenge, being replaced by [[Chela Nayss]] instead.<ref name="Nathema" />
